premises.text: Large volumes of pre-consumer food waste and rising protein shortage create a dual problem that converting waste into protein can address
premises.evidence_span: if somehow we can convert pre-consumer food waste into protein, we can offer a sustainable solution for both problems

premises.text: A hatchery-plus-incubator insect system converts ground food waste into edible insects and fertilizer, then dries insects into protein powder
premises.evidence_span: placing the insect in a specially designed hatchery that provides the optimal egg production

premises.text: Revenue comes from being paid to take food waste plus selling insect protein powder and fertilizer
premises.evidence_span: Companies pay us to get rid of their food waste. So we get revenue by taking our raw material and by selling our insect-based protein powder and the fertilizer

premises.text: Production needs minimal water and land, zero grain, and near-zero carbon, with higher protein/minerals than regular meat
premises.evidence_span: It needs minimal water and land, requires zero grain, and almost produces zero carbon emission

premises.text: Initial market is pet protein (reptile, fish, bird) via influencers and pet shops, with later human segments such as athletes and patients who cannot eat regular meat
premises.evidence_span: We launched our first product in May for reptile, fish and bird

premises.text: Insect protein is cheaper/more accessible than plant-based, artificial meat, or cricket alternatives that are costly or not scalable
premises.evidence_span: There are other alternatives, but they are cost prohibitively expensive to compare with regular meat

value.text: Sustainable next-generation protein from edible insects that also valorizes food waste
value.evidence_span: Natransa produces the next generation protein from a specific edible insect by converting food waste into fertilizer

secondary_value.text: Healthier and more sustainable protein sources for humans at scale
secondary_value.evidence_span: producing much healthier and more sustainable protein sources for humans

causal_links.evidence_span: convert pre-consumer food waste into protein
dry and grind the insect into protein powder, which is ready for consumption
Companies pay us to get rid of their food waste
same protein sources are used for pets and humans

notes: Hatchery/incubator/filter/dry steps folded into one production mechanism (v1.3.2 #5). Traction metrics and accelerator bios excluded; lab/FAO approvals treated as validation evidence not separate premises. Big human-protein vision kept as secondary_value not a premise (v1.3.2 #4).
